title: Tutorials for Introduction to Modern Statistics
text: recommended way launch tutorials R Tutorials extension VS Code, lists every installed tutorial lets start one click. backup, can launch tutorial R console learnr2::run_tutorial(), providing short name tutorial package name. Hello Data (“hello-data”). Chapter 1: stent experiment, cases variables loan50, associations among US counties, experiments versus observational studies. Study Design (“study-design”). Chapter 2: populations samples using mlb salaries, simple random stratified sampling, malaria vaccine experiment. Applications: Data (“applications-data”). Chapter 3: getting know paralympic_1500, Simpson’s paradox 1500m gold medal times. Exploring Categorical Data (“exploring-categorical-data”). Chapter 4: contingency tables, bar plots, conditional proportions loans_full_schema, comparing county incomes across groups. Exploring Numerical Data (“exploring-numerical-data”). Chapter 5: histograms, shape, summary statistics loan50, transformations intensity maps county. Applications: Explore (“applications-explore”). Chapter 6: communicating exploratory results, keeping plots simple, using color draw attention, telling story population change county, order, labels, purpose, color chapter’s Brexit poll. Linear Regression Single Predictor (“linear-regression-single”). Chapter 7: fitting least squares line, residuals, correlation, R-squared, two-level categorical predictor, outliers, possum, elmhurst, mariokart. Linear Regression Multiple Predictors (“linear-regression-multiple”). Chapter 8: indicator categorical predictors, many predictors, adjusted R-squared, backward forward selection, modeling interest rates loans_full_schema. Logistic Regression (“logistic-regression”). Chapter 9: callback rates resume hiring experiment, logit, logistic models one many predictors, predicted probabilities, groups different sizes. Applications: Model (“applications-model”). Chapter 10: case study house prices duke_forest, correlation one-predictor model multiple regression chosen backward elimination.
